items.name: Marek Hora
items.short: Ambassador of Japanese cuisine in the Czech Republic and an acclaimed chef with experience in Europe and Japan.
items.description: He will demonstrate fresh fish preparation and make sashimi, nigiri, maki and other sushi.

content.text: Marek Hora has worked with Japanese cuisine for more than thirty years and has also trained in Japan.
In Považská Bystrica he will demonstrate practical fish preparation and sushi techniques.

items.name: Gorin
items.short: A group focused on samurai culture, historical martial traditions and the Sengoku period.
items.description: Expect archery, combat demonstrations, tameshigiri and stories about samurai traditions.

content.text: Gorin brings the atmosphere of samurai Japan to Považská Bystrica.
The programme includes archery, combat demonstrations and tameshigiri sword cutting.

items.name: Noriko Komiyama
items.short: Japanese instructor of the Sogetsu school of ikebana.
items.description: She will present Japanese flower arranging and differences between Ikenobo and Sogetsu approaches.

content.text: Noriko Komiyama is a Japanese Sogetsu ikebana instructor.
She shows that striking ikebana can be created with ordinary flowers and local materials.

items.name: Martin Labudík
items.short: Founder of Nagomi tea and Japanese tea instructor.
items.description: He will present Japanese tea, brewing, farm work in Japan and topics around green tea and antioxidants.

content.text: Martin Labudík of Nagomi tea presents the diversity of Japanese tea and practical preparation.
He will also talk about work on a Japanese tea farm, processing, antioxidants and oxidative stress.
